units.source_text: 在伊东重开对局以来，大竹七段不断推敲，坚忍不拔，慎重而稳健。

en.t: Since the game resumed in Ito, Otake 7-dan had kept pondering the position, showing persistence, caution, and steadiness.

units.source_text: 黑子昂扬的力量终于爆发了，那就是129压头的一手。

en.t: Black's rising strength finally burst forth in the head-pressing move at 129.

units.source_text: 我们对白130的脱先不禁大吃一惊。

en.t: We could not help being greatly startled that White 130 tenukied.
The 7-dan was probably not frightened, I suppose.

units.source_text: 倘使白吃掉右边的黑四子，黑则长驱直入，掏尽中央的白地。

en.t: If White captured the four black stones on the right, Black would drive straight in and hollow out all of White's territory in the center.

units.source_text: 七段对白130置之不理，从黑129位长到131位。

en.t: The 7-dan ignored White 130 and extended from Black's position at 129 to 131.

units.source_text: 果然，名人以白132回粘，应付中央的激战。

en.t: As expected, the Meijin returned with White 132 to connect and deal with the fierce fight in the center.

units.source_text: 白130如果直接应，不脱先就好了。

en.t: It would have been better if White 130 had answered directly instead of tenuki.
